unsettable.temperature: not supported by the model; sent as null
unsettable.top_p: not supported by the model; sent as null

reader: same model and effort as the negotiators

format.free: Write your message as one or two plain English sentences.
format.tagged: Start your message with exactly one performative tag in parentheses, one of (propose), (accept-proposal), (reject-proposal), (refuse), then write one plain English sentence.
format.structured: Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else: {"performative": "propose" | "accept-proposal" | "reject-proposal" | "refuse", "content": {"price": <whole number or null>}}.

roles.buyer: You are the buyer of {item}, negotiating the price with the seller. Your private limit: you can pay at most {limit}. Never agree to a price above {limit}.
roles.seller: You are the seller of {item}. You can accept at least {limit}. Never agree to a price below {limit}.

common: Four acts are available: propose (offer a price), accept-proposal (agree to the other side's last price, which ends the negotiation with a deal), reject-proposal (decline the last price and keep negotiating), refuse (leave the negotiation for good, no deal).
reader_system: You are an observer reading a price negotiation between a buyer and a seller. Label the LAST message only. Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else: {"performative": "propose" | "accept-proposal" | "reject-proposal" | "refuse", "price": <whole number or null>}.
